name: THE WATER TREATMENT PLANT
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: The map seats the valley's water treatment at the lake ('WATER SYSTEM STAPLES (grounded 7/5/26): treatment at the lake (Alfred Merritt Smith analog), reservoir tanks on the foothills, a pumping station on the aqueduct path', engine/bohemia_overmap.js).

A water treatment plant filters the lake's water through filter beds, concrete basins of water over sand and gravel in rows, walkways between them and the pipe gallery under; the treated water goes out through the high-service pump hall: big pumps on plinths, manifolds of pipe as wide as a man, the motor control cabinets, and the chemical room's tanks.
On house tiles a filter bed is a basin nobody walks into and a man is seen across; a pump or a chemical tank hides a man; a leak on the floor is standing water, Battle Brothers' swamp.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (watertreat_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The plant is its buildings and the yards and settling basins between them: about one fight in three there is fought inside, in the filter gallery or the pump hall, by the cell's own dice; the rest in the yards.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The plant's concrete wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The plant's wet concrete: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

filterbed.effect: A filter bed, a concrete basin of still water over sand behind its railing: nobody walks into it; a man is seen across it; cover beside its wall. [bb] its palisade you see through.

pipes.effect: Pipe runs across the floor, a man steps over them: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
pipes.say: Pipes underfoot: slow going, low cover.

valves.effect: A filter's valve console, wheels and gauges on a steel stand: cover.

leak.effect: A leak pooled on the floor, ankle deep and slick: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
leak.say: Standing water: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

desk.effect: An operator's desk, its screens dark: cover.

drums.effect: Drums of coagulant and chlorine, empty: low cover.

pump.effect: A high-service pump on its plinth, its motor taller than a man: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

manifold.effect: A manifold of pipe as wide as a man, on its saddles: cover.

cabinets.effect: The motor control cabinets, steel, their doors hanging: cover.

tank.effect: A chemical tank in its bund: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The plant's doors, open onto the yard: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in watertreat_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the walkways over the beds are the floor's own level on house tiles; the pumps are blockers.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the gallery's roof trusses and the pump hall's crane rail, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
